sentences.text:
Before
 Hon'Ble Shri Justice Pramod Kumar Agrawal
 On The 7 th Of October, 2025
 Misc. Criminal Case No. 39424 of 2025
 Suraj Ahirwar
 Versus
 The State Of Madhya Pradesh And Others
 Appearance:
 Shri Manoj Kumar Mishra - Advocate for the applicant.
 Shri Pramod Pandey - Government Advocate for State.

Shri Vivek Shukla - Advocate for the respondent No.2/obj
 Order

This is the fourth bail application filed by the applicant under Section 483 of BNSS/ 439 of Cr.P.C.
for grant of regular bail relating to Crime No. 572/2023 registered at Police Station - Civil Line,
District- Chhatarpur (M.P.) for the offence punishable under Sections 363, 376(2)(n), 376(1), 450,
323, 34, 506 of IPC and section 5L/6, 3/4 of POCSO Act.
Applicant is in detention since 02.07.2024.
Previous bail applications were dismissed as withdrawn.
2. As per the prosecution story, it is alleged that applicant has committed rape upon prosecutrix.
After investigation, offence under the aforesaid section has been registered against the applicant.
3. Learned counsel for the applicant submits that applicant is in jail since 02.07.2024.
He is innocent and has been falsely implicated in this case.
Missing report of prosecutrix was lodged on 29.07.2023 whereas prosecutrix was recovered from her parents house on 14.09.2023.
In medical examination, age of the prosecutrix was found 18 years.
DNA report is negative.
Due to pressure of NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-JBP:50639 2 MCRC-39424-2025 her parents, prosecutrix has lodged this false report.
Applicant has no criminal past and conclusion of the trial will take considerable time, therefore, it has been prayed that the applicant may be released on bail.

4 . On the other hand, learned counsel for State as well as objector have opposed the grant of bail to the applicant and submitted that prosecutrix in her Court statement as well as in her statement recorded under Section 183 of BNSS has deposed against the applicant and supported the prosecution story.

Date of birth of the prosecutrix is 05.08.2006 therefore, at the time of incident,
she was minor.
Applicant has committed rape upon minor prosecutrix.

Therefore, bail may not be Suraj Ahirwar vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 7 October, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/66182128/
1 granted to the applicant.

sentences.text:
5. Heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record.
6.
Looking to the overall facts and circumstances of the case and seriousness of offence, this Court is not inclined to grant regular bail to the applicant.
7. Accordingly, this MCRC stands dismissed.

8. Since applicant is under custody since 02.07.2024 and trial is not completed, learned Trial Court is directed to conclude the trial expeditiously preferably within a period of six months from the date of receipt of copy of this order.
9. Registry is directed to send a copy of this order to the concerned trial Court for necessary compliance.
